name: Battle Horn: teaches the horn, which pulls enemies within 30 yards only
contract: Item 898070 casts Learning (55884), teaching spell 898070 and spending the item. Spell 898070 is an instant SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT on TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY around the caster with radius index 10 (30 yards) and a 45 second recovery, so an enemy 10 yards away enters combat with the caster and one 45 yards away does not.

steps.label: The near enemy starts out of combat
The far enemy starts out of combat
The Battle Horn teaches its ability
The Battle Horn item is spent
Clear the global cooldown of the learning cast
The enemy inside 30 yards is pulled into combat
The horn starts its 45 second recovery
Give the far enemy the same window
The enemy outside 30 yards is left alone
